notes: Submodule repositories are never cloned. Dependency edges come from .gitmodules and Cargo.toml text already present in this working tree.
include_globs is extension-based and is applied to the whole repository path, so '*.rs' keeps any Rust file at any depth.
FalkorDB vendors third-party C under src/ (LAGraph, Dijkstra). Those are .c/.h and are excluded because they are not project source; set include_globs to '*.c' and '*.h' to keep them.
deps/ is excluded because it holds submodule checkouts whose contents belong to other repositories.

.claude/, .opencode/ and .codex/ are excluded because they hold coding-agent configuration and skill documents rather than project source; the '*.md' include glob would otherwise admit them as if they were documentation.
